title: Thirteen Winters and One Broken Fence
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：deer　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 deer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 the keeper ① tracked a deer that no hunter in the forest would have followed, and he said the tracking was the whole of the winter. The ② deer, meaning the animal and not the herd, ran thirteen winters and stayed uncounted; a deer, he said, is the only thing in a wood that is judged by how long it is left unnumbered.

Every ③ deer in that wood had the same broken fence at the edge of it, and the ④ deer at the end, meaning the one that came down to the water and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever saw twice. A deer, his daughter said, is nine parts silence and one part somebody willing to wait; the keeper said the waiting is the part that fills thirteen winters.

The warden meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the deer was the whole of the forest, meaning the herd and not the animal. The ⑥ deer, meaning the herd and not any of that, is the only thing in a forest that everybody counts and nobody approaches; deer, he said, is either something you track or the only word that means both an animal and a herd. He said the herd is the part they remember.

By 1956 the ⑦ deer had become a line in a count, and the count had become an argument about the broken fence. The ⑧ deer of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in December, was one wood and thirteen winters of waiting; deer, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to wait. She said the waiting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ deer I remember is the one at the end, which was last seen in 1969 and is still described as the oldest in the wood. A ⑩ deer, his daughter said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being waited for; every deer, she said, is a herd that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the herd was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 鹿（指林子里出现的那一只）
B. n. 鹿（指那只动物本身，与那群鹿相对）
C. 固定搭配：track a deer 追踪一只鹿
D. n. 鹿（指走到水边来的那一只）
E. n. 鹿；鹿群（抽象总称，指一片林子里的鹿之全体）
F. n. 鹿（指统计表上记入、被清点的那一只）
G. n. 鹿群（指整片森林的鹿群种群）
H. n. 鹿群（抽象总称，指人人清点却无人靠近的那群）

items.q: tracked a deer that no hunter in the forest would have followed
The deer, meaning the animal and not the herd
the deer was the whole of the forest

answers.why: track a deer 意为“追踪一只鹿”，1947 年看林人追踪了一只森林里没有一位猎人肯跟下去的鹿。
deer 意为“鹿”，指那只动物本身而不是那群鹿，它历经十三个冬天而从未被清点。
deer 意为“鹿”，指那片林子里每一只鹿，每一只的边界处都有同一道破篱笆。
deer 意为“鹿”，指走到水边来的那一只，是唯一有人见过两次的。
deer 意为“鹿群”，指整片森林的鹿群种群，管理员说这群鹿就是那片森林的全部。
deer 意为“鹿群”，指人人清点却无人靠近的那群而不是那只动物本身，是森林里人人都清点、却无人靠近的东西。
deer 意为“鹿”，指统计表上记入、被清点的那一只，到 1956 年这只鹿成了统计里的一行。
deer 意为“鹿、鹿群”，看林人十二月写道，整件事的鹿事是一片林子和十三个冬天的等待。
deer 意为“鹿”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1969 年最后一次被看见，至今仍被说成林子里最老的。
deer 为抽象总称，他的女儿 1971 年说，一只鹿是唯一会因为被等待而变得更好的生灵。
